title: A2N agent output (a2n-notation-fixer)
description: Backfills correct inline-notation (exponents, subscripts, radicals) onto an A2 page read before the check's superscript-folding behaviour was understood. Never edits the original A2 output -- this is a separate, additive file keyed by the same page id.

n.description: Must match a block's own `n` in the real A2 output for this page.

no_change.description: True when this block's inline notation was already correct -- nothing to fix. Mutually exclusive with corrected_text.

corrected_text.description: The block's full text, with every flattened exponent restored to a real Unicode superscript/subscript and every dropped radical restored. Every prose word must be identical to the original, in the same order -- only digits and math symbols may differ.

fixes.description: What changed and why it's needed, one entry per correction made, e.g. {"wrong": "1011", "right": "10\u00b9\u00b9"}. Required when corrected_text is given.
